import sys,subprocess,hashlib,json,datetime,urllib.request,urllib.parse,concurrent.futures,os
repo=Path('/workspace/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn')
sha,base,directory,receipt=sys.argv[1:]
dest=Path(directory);assert not dest.exists();dest.mkdir(parents=True)
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=repo)
changed=git('diff','--name-status',base,sha).decode().splitlines()
assert all(row.split('\t')[0] in {'A','M','D'} for row in changed),changed

 mode,kind,blob=meta[path];assert kind=='blob' and mode in {'100644','100755'}
 url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/'+sha+'/'+urllib.parse.quote(path)

 target=dest/path;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(b);target.chmod(0o755 if mode=='100755' else 0o644)
 assert target.read_bytes()==b
 return dict(path=path,mode=mode,git_blob=blob,bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),url=url)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:files=list(pool.map(one,paths))
